contexts.text: By which all things germinate and flourish.
It was as budding () = influx by which comes rebirth; (for) to bud, or produce leaves and afterwards the flower, = the first of the rebirth...
As when a tree buds...
The three shoots, then the budding, then the flower...
Budding after them () = appearing near; (for) to bud, here, = to appear.
And shall devour every tree germinating to you from the field () = the consuming of all the knowledges which they had from the Church.
Hence it is that a horn is said to bud (), because all spiritual budding is of truth from good; and therefore also they formerly made horns budding.
The sun cannot... produce germinations in the Earth immediately, but produces them from the matters of the soil...
Vegetable growths.
All things of the Earth germinate according to...
Hence come the germinations of your Earth.
Marriage love then begins... to bud and flower.
Vernal heat, from the influx of which all things tend to germinations and fructifications.
There would be no beginning of germination (in seeds). TCR 585:end.
To make his horn to bud = the multiplication of Divine truth...
Plantation takes place in the interiors of man, where is the good of love and charity; and germination, in the exteriors of man, where is the good of life.
Who maketh grass to grow on the mountains () = nourishment thus for those who are in the good of love.
The beginning of a new Church is signified by... the earth germinating anew ().
To water the earth, that it may bring forth and bud () = to vivify the Church, that it may produce the truth of doctrine and faith, and the good of love and charity.
To bless the budding thereof () = to produce continually anew, and to cause truths to spring forth.
Jehovah maketh the grass to bud forth for the beast... () = the instruction and nourishment of the natural... man by truths from the Word...
To cause grass to grow () = the instruction of the natural man by Knowledges from the Word.
From which comes all germination of truth, and fructification of good.
When the herb germinated... () = when truth grew... The herb germinating = truth such as it is when first received.
Heat united to light... gives soul to germinations. Spiritual germinations are the productions of wisdom from love...
As... heat... produces germinations by means of light... So thoughts are the germinations of the marriage (of love and truth).
All these things are germinations from the earths there.
Like the germinations of the Earth, which cannot be formed from the essence itself of the sun...
